 1834 Battle::ItemEffects::EndOfRoundHealing.add(:BLACKSLUDGE,
 1835   proc { |item, battler, battle|
 1836     if battler.pbHasType?(:POISON)
 1837       next if !battler.canHeal?
 1838       battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", battler)
 1839       battler.pbRecoverHP(battler.totalhp / 16)
 1840       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} restored a little HP using its {2}!",
 1841          battler.pbThis, battler.itemName))
 1842     elsif battler.takesIndirectDamage?
 1843       battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", battler)
 1844       battler.pbTakeEffectDamage(battler.totalhp / 8) do |hp_lost|
 1845         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is hurt by its {2}!", battler.pbThis, battler.itemName))
 1846       end
 1847     end
 1848   }
 1849 )
